name: Synapse Analytics
description: 面向银行和金融机构的 AI 信贷决策平台，帮助机构管理信贷风险。
description_en: An AI credit-decisioning platform for banks and financial institutions, focused on credit-risk management.
why_matters: 公司称，其平台已支持超过 2 亿美元贷款，并帮助客户将不良贷款减少最多 40%。这些业务指标提供了评估信贷决策应用的具体线索。
why_matters_en: The company says its platform has supported more than $200 million in lending and helped clients reduce non-performing loans by up to 40%. These reported figures give a concrete basis for examining its credit-decisioning use case.
latest_news: 完成由Partech领投、Algebra Ventures和Silicon Badia参与的1300万美元A轮融资,成立至今总融资额达1700万美元
latest_news_en: Raised $13mn Series A led by Partech with participation from Algebra Ventures and Silicon Badia, bringing total funding since inception to $17mn
source_title: South Africa and Egypt Contest Africa’s AI Funding Crown - Launch Base Africa

website_verification.title: Synapse Analytics | AI Credit Risk Automation Platform

evidence.quote: Synapse Analytics, a Cairo-founded decisioning platform for banks and financial institutions, raised $13mn in Series A funding led by Paris-based Partech, with Algebra Ventures and Silicon Badia participating.
The company says it has supported more than $200mn in lending and helped clients reduce non-performing loans by up to 40 per cent.

name: 42AI
description: 开发行为世界模型的以色列-美国初创公司,能够预测个人在新情况下的决策倾向,通过分析心理特征而非历史行为模式来生成决策概率分布
description_en: Israeli-American startup developing a behavioral world model that can predict individual decision-making tendencies in new situations by analyzing psychological traits rather than historical behavior patterns to generate probability distributions
why_matters: 已在 10 家大型经纪商部署,用于管理流动性、保证金要求和对冲风险,声称交易预测准确率达 98%,F1 分数为 0.8-0.85,一家经纪商通过动态对冲产生约 3000 万美元额外价值,展示了实际商业影响力
why_matters_en: Deployed at 10 large brokerages for managing liquidity, margin requirements, and hedging exposure, claiming 98% accuracy in trade prediction and F1 scores of 0.8-0.85, with one brokerage generating approximately $30 million in additional value through dynamic hedging, demonstrating real commercial impact
latest_news: 2026年11月完成 6250 万美元种子轮融资,资金来自创始人和 Infinity Group,客户数据集已覆盖近 3000 万人,收入达到七位数规模
latest_news_en: Completed $62.5 million seed funding in November 2026 from founders and Infinity Group, with customer datasets covering nearly 30 million people and generating over seven figures in revenue
source_title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can 'predict human behavior' | TechCrunch

evidence.quote: it has just come out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding

42AI spent three years developing this approach, combining psychological research with neuroscience and genetics, as well as advice from experts in psychology and PTSD, and Dan Shechtman, who was awarded the 2011 Nobel Prize in Chemistry

name: Rently
description: 为租户提供灵活分期支付租金、赚取积分奖励和管理付款计划的租赁支付平台,允许租户延迟租金支付、降低入住成本并在每笔租金支付中赚取里程积分
description_en: A rental payments platform that allows tenants to pay rent in flexible installments, earn rewards, and manage payment schedules, with features including deferred payments and reduced move-in costs
why_matters: 通过分期和延迟支付服务处理租户的租金安排。来源记录，2026 年前九个月新加坡租户交易量为 3630 万新元，是 2025 年同期的 2.5 倍。
why_matters_en: Its installment and deferred-payment services address how tenants manage rent payments. The source reports S$36.3 million in rental transactions from Singaporean tenants in the first nine months of 2026, 2.5 times the corresponding 2025 period.
latest_news: 2026年10月获得1200万美元债务融资,用于在现有市场扩展租金灵活支付服务,并为2027年推出新市场的A轮融资做准备
latest_news_en: Secured US$12 million debt financing in October 2026 to extend rent flexibility offering and prepare for Series A round to launch additional markets in 2027
source_title: 5 Up-and-Coming Proptech Startups from Singapore to Watch - Fintech Singapore

evidence.quote: In October 2026, Rently secured US$12 million in debt financing to extend its rent flexibility offering across its existing markets.

In the first nine months of 2026, rental transaction volume from Singaporean tenants using Rently reached SGD 36.3 million (US$28.4 million), representing a 2.5-fold increase over the corresponding period in 2025

name: Primero
description: 面向大型企业的 AI 系统集成平台，通过 Primia 连接碎片化的遗留系统与 AI 代理。
description_en: An AI integration platform for large enterprises. Its Primia platform connects fragmented legacy systems to AI agents.
why_matters: 聚焦企业在现有业务系统中接入 AI 代理的需求。来源列出的客户包括 Kimberly-Clark de México 和 SmartFit，可进一步了解其在大型企业中的实际应用。
why_matters_en: It focuses on bringing AI agents into existing enterprise systems. The source names Kimberly-Clark de México and SmartFit as customers, offering a starting point for examining its enterprise use.
latest_news: 2026 年 8 月完成 1200 万美元种子轮融资，由 Kaszek 和 General Catalyst 共同领投。
latest_news_en: Raised a $12 million seed round in August 2026, co-led by Kaszek and General Catalyst.
source_title: Born in LatAm, built for the world: 15 AI leaders to watch in 2027

website_verification.title: Primero | Latin America's AI transformation company Primero AI

evidence.quote: In August 2026 Primero raised a $12 million seed round co-led by Kaszek and General Catalyst.
Its Primia platform connects large companies' fragmented legacy systems to AI agents. Customers include Kimberly-Clark de México and SmartFit

name: Kora Systems
description: 一款基于Linux的桌面操作系统,将AI模型和自主代理直接集成到计算体验中,允许它们跨应用程序工作、访问文件并在任务之间保留上下文。由Cyanogen联合创始人Kirt McMaster创立,专为重度AI用户设计
description_en: A Linux-based desktop operating system that integrates AI models and autonomous agents directly into the computing experience, allowing them to work across applications, access files, and retain context between tasks. Founded by Cyanogen co-founder Kirt McMaster, designed for heavy AI users
why_matters: 由挑战过Google Android的Cyanogen联合创始人打造,针对微软Windows在AI时代的替代方案。利用AI编码工具使开发速度提升至少5倍,约50名工程师团队。预计2027年作为免费桌面操作系统推出,支持Intel、AMD和高通骁龙芯片。获得三星Next、Square Enix等投资
why_matters_en: Built by Cyanogen co-founder who challenged Google's Android, targeting Microsoft Windows as an alternative for the AI era. Using AI coding tools accelerated development by at least fivefold with about 50 engineers. Expected to launch in 2027 as free desktop OS supporting Intel, AMD and Qualcomm Snapdragon chips. Backed by Samsung Next, Square Enix and others
latest_news: 2026年11月公开亮相,前身为游戏操作系统公司Playtron,2025年7月更名为Kora并转向AI操作系统。与高通密切合作近一年优化骁龙芯片支持,并与沙特AI公司Humain合作开发企业版Humain OS
latest_news_en: Unveiled publicly in November 2026, previously known as gaming OS company Playtron, rebranded as Kora in July 2025 shifting focus to AI. Worked closely with Qualcomm for nearly a year to optimize for Snapdragon chips, and partnered with Saudi AI company Humain on enterprise version Humain OS
source_title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era

evidence.quote: Kora's investors include Samsung Next, Square Enix, Alumni Ventures, Polychain, VanEck, and Circle, all of which previously backed Playtron. The company, McMaster said, has raised additional funding since shifting its focus to AI

Almost a decade after Cyanogen shut down its Android operating-system business following a years-long, unsuccessful effort to loosen Google's dominance, its co-founder, Kirt McMaster, is now targeting Microsoft's Windows

Kora is designed to let users work with different AI models and agents across applications, while keeping track of conversations, documents, and other information. It also allows AI agents to operate in separate workspaces with restricted access to files and other resources

name: Bay
description: 为企业提供AI代理安全控制平台。安全团队可通过会话级别上下文评估AI代理的每项操作是否安全，在毫秒级别进行实时决策，无需部署端点代理、内核驱动或网络代理。
description_en: Enterprise platform for controlling AI agent actions through session-context enforcement. Evaluates whether proposed actions are safe based on full agent session context and real-time observability, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale while maintaining security controls.
why_matters: 解决AI代理权限滥用问题。创始人来自以色列Unit 8200和CrowdStrike，具有深厚的安全背景。已获得Fortune 100客户采用，并将其平台使用量增加三倍。
why_matters_en: Addresses critical AI agent authorization drift—agents can misuse legitimate permissions for dangerous actions. Founded by leaders from Israel's Unit 8200 cyber intelligence unit and CrowdStrike's 90-engineer department. Deployed by Fortune 100 companies, tripling autonomous agent use while maintaining control.
latest_news: 2026年11月10日从隐身模式现身，宣布完成3700万美元Series A融资，由Battery Ventures领投。总融资达5000万美元（包括之前未披露的1300万美元种子轮）。客户包括Micron、Peloton、ClickUp和Wix。
latest_news_en: Emerged from stealth on November 10, 2026, announcing $37M Series A led by Battery Ventures, bringing total funding to $50M (including previously undisclosed $13M seed co-led by YL Ventures and Striker). Microsoft's M12 and Wiz CEO Assaf Rappaport participated. Early customers include Micron, Peloton, ClickUp, and Wix.

evidence.quote: Bay announced on November 10, 2026, that it had raised a $37 million Series A led by Battery Ventures, bringing total funding to $50 million as the Tel Aviv-based startup emerged from stealth with a platform designed to control what enterprise AI agents can do.

Zacharia founded Bay with chief product officer Aner Morag and research-and-development vice president Boris Danilovich. She previously led a 50-person department in Israel's Unit 8200 and later served as director of research and AI at Hunters. Danilovich previously led a 90-engineer department at CrowdStrike, while Morag joined Noname Security as an early employee and became vice president of product.
Bay reports that it has dozens of enterprise customers at launch, including Micron, Peloton, ClickUp and Wix, and that Fortune 100 companies used its platform to triple autonomous AI agent use.

source_title: Bay Raises $37M Series A to Scale Enterprise AI Agent Security – Unite.AI
